name: Signoria Creation Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2019, Signoria Creation Ltd
 is engaged in manufacturing and marketing 
of women apparels[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SCL is a fashion house focused on traditional designs and ethnic wear for women, catering to both everyday fashion and special occasions. The company specializes in selling a wide range of Indian ethnic apparel, including Kurtis, Kurti-Pant sets, Kurti-Pant-Dupatta sets, Co-ord sets, Gowns, and Tops.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 199 days.
